about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Who is behind Agence Edson?
about.desc:
I am a passionate computer science student who views the web as a tool for performance and automation.

My goal with Agence Edson is to provide local businesses with a modern, sharp, and premium online image. But beyond the visuals, I build websites that actually work for you. By automating repetitive tasks — like showcasing your services, menus, or handling inquiries —, your site saves you precious hours every week.

Less time wasted on logistics means more time to invest in growing your business or spending with your family. I focus on a transparent, efficient, and jargon-free approach to elevate your internet presence.
